## When can you share data

- How do you know you can share data?

## How do you know you cannot share data?

- Licenses and Data use agreements: Example 1 ([PSID](https://simba.isr.umich.edu/U/CondUse.aspx)), Example 2 (Demographic and Health Surveys, [DHS](https://dhsprogram.com/data/dataset_admin/login_main.cfm)), 
- Institutional review board (IRB) restrictions
- Confidentiality agreements
- Legal restrictions (🇪🇺 GDPR, [🇧🇷 LGPD](https://www.dlapiperdataprotection.com/?t=law&c=BR))

- [Discussion on data ethics (video)](https://labordynamicsinstitute.github.io/crress/#session-2)
  - Meyer, M. N. (2018). [Practical tips for ethical data sharing](http://journals.sagepub.com/doi/pdf/10.1177/2515245917747656). Advances in Methods and Practices in Psychological Science, 1(1), 131-144. <https://doi.org/10.1177/2515245917747656>

## How do you know you have data you cannot share?

- Best practices for separating shareable and non-shareable data: [J-PAL guide for de-identification of data](https://www.povertyactionlab.org/sites/default/files/research-resources/J-PAL-guide-to-deidentifying-data.pdf) starts on Day 1
- Did you properly separate shareable and non-shareable data? Verify on Day T-1: [PII-checker](https://github.com/valentadavid/pii-checker)
  - How can you decide what data to publish without publishing the data? Private LLMs...

## Methods to make non-shareable data shareable

- Data de-identification 
- True data anonymization: k-anonymity [![Open In Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/assets/colab-badge.svg)](https://colab.research.google.com/github/labordynamicsinstitute/reproducibility-curriculum/blob/main/extras/k_anonymity_tutorial.ipynb), differential privacy (🎥 [Video](https://youtu.be/pT19VwBAqKA?t=350), [Garfinkel, Simson, J. M. Abowd, and Christian Martindale. 2018. “Understanding Database Reconstruction Attacks on Public Data.” Acmqueue 16 (5).](https://queue.acm.org/detail.cfm?id=3295691), also [Webb, Kaitlyn R., Soumya Mukherjee, Aratrika Mustafi, Aleksandra Slavković, and **Lars Vilhuber**. 2026. Assessing Utility of Differential Privacy for RCTs. Arxiv:2309.14581v2.](https://doi.org/10.48550/ARXIV.2309.14581).

- Aggregation and summarization
- Synthetic data generation

## Methods to publish data securely with controls

- Data repositories (e.g., [ICPSR](https://www.icpsr.umich.edu/web/pages/), [Dataverse](https://dataverse.org/)) have mechanisms
- Journal policies require "5 years retention" - how do you ensure that?
- Flip: You are the licensor!
